text.description_html:
Schlage F62CEN, Modern Century Double Cylinder Handleset

This Schlage made handleset has stylish square mounts on the outside. Available in 5 finishes, the Century Handleset is exemplary of quality. When you have a Schlage handleset on your front door, you know your home is secure. The Century Handleset features a rugged all-metal chassis and a solid brass construction for security. This modern handleset is ANSI Grade 1 security rated. A double cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key on both the interior and exterior; and the latchbolt is operated by a turnknob interior and a thumbpiece exterior.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt on this double cylinder handleset is thrown or retracted by a key from the both the exterior and the interior. The latch is retracted by a thumbpiece from the exterior and by a turn knob on the interior.

Also available matching:
Century Single Cylinder Handleset
Century Dummy Handleset

Features of the Schlage Century Handleset:

  • ANSI A156.5 Grade 1 security.
  • Easy installation.
  • All metal chassis for strength and durability.
  • 3 screw door frame reinforcer.
  • Guaranteed to fit all standard door preparations.
  • C keyway comes packaged with 2 keys.

Specifications of the Double Cylinder Century Handleset:

  • Door Thickness: 1-5/8" to 2"
  • Outside Handle Length: 12-1/8"
  • Outside Handle Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Backset: will fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • 5-1/2" center to center deadbolt to latch spacing
  • Adjustable throughbolt can move up and down 1-1/2" to fit a variety of pre-existing holes
  • Door Thickness: will fit 1-5/8" up to 1-3/4" packaged with extra screws to accommodate 2" doors

The inside trim will match the outside handleset's finish.
